subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Should Feishu command-only text during active runs restore the documented bypass for all reported commands, including stateful `/stop` and `/new`, or only for a safer local subset such as `/status`?
rationale: Current main has a partial `/stop` queue lane but no complete structured text-command fast path; choosing which stateful commands may bypass active-run ordering changes session behavior and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep broad bug open and choose policy
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Feishu active-run command bug while maintainers decide the stateful command boundary before accepting another fix.

options.title: Land only a safe subset
options.body: Accept a narrow `/status`-style local fast path and leave `/stop` and `/new` to a separate sponsored design or bug once the risks are explicit.

options.title: Restore all reported commands
options.body: Sponsor a broader Feishu fix that marks authorized command-only text turns and queue lanes for `/status`, `/stop`, and `/new`, with live active-run proof.

recommendation.title: Keep broad bug open and choose policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Feishu active-run command bug while maintainers decide the stateful command boundary before accepting another fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The current source and policy decision route through the latest source-carrier history, and the remaining question is maintainer product direction rather than a purely mechanical fix.
